the_leader.name: Natural Leader
the_leader.oneLine: An alpha character who takes responsibility and commands the room in times of crisis.
the_leader.cardLine: The decisive figure everyone turns to when asking 'what are we doing next?'

the_visionary.name: Original Mind
the_visionary.oneLine: A sharp mind whose brain works differently, setting the group's vision.
the_visionary.cardLine: A deep perspective easily bored by superficial small talk.

the_magnet.name: Social Magnet
the_magnet.oneLine: A high-aura profile who catches immediate attention in any room with charm.
the_magnet.cardLine: Natural charisma that pulls the spotlight without even trying.

the_safe_haven.name: Safe Haven
the_safe_haven.oneLine: A solid, honest character offering zero judgment and infinite trust.
the_safe_haven.cardLine: The very first person you would call at 3 AM if you got into trouble.

the_social_star.name: Social Star
the_social_star.oneLine: The life of the group whose absence cancels plans; pure positive vibes.
the_social_star.cardLine: Contagious high energy that melts the ice in seconds and starts the party.

the_elite_mind.name: Elite Mind
the_elite_mind.oneLine: A charismatic profile with high standards who doesn't easily bend to anyone.
the_elite_mind.cardLine: A refined standard that rejects mediocrity and commands respect instantly.

the_noble_heart.name: Noble Heart
the_noble_heart.oneLine: A golden-hearted person who never hesitates to share what they have with others.
the_noble_heart.cardLine: Pure sincerity whose hand reaches for the check first, never keeping score.

the_silent_king.name: Silent Power
the_silent_king.oneLine: A mature intellect who speaks rarely but wisely, making everyone listen.
the_silent_king.cardLine: A quiet but incredibly deep authority that solves problems without the noise.

the_alpha_achiever.name: Peak Partner
the_alpha_achiever.oneLine: An ambitious profile with sky-high confidence who gets whatever they target.
the_alpha_achiever.cardLine: An unwavering drive fully aware of their value, building life on grand goals.

the_benevolent_guide.name: Wise Anchor
the_benevolent_guide.oneLine: The mentor of the group who keeps everyone grounded financially and emotionally.
the_benevolent_guide.cardLine: A mature shelter you can lean on, protecting those around in stormy times.

the_ice_queen_king.name: Ice Queen/King
the_ice_queen_king.oneLine: A distant profile drawing focus with a striking aura but hard to get close to.
the_ice_queen_king.cardLine: Stunning from a distance but keeping their doors locked to the crowd.

the_mastermind.name: Mastermind
the_mastermind.oneLine: Hyperactive and sharp-witted; a fast-talker and the ultimate joke machine.
the_mastermind.cardLine: A rapid brainstorm whose quick comebacks control the room.

the_playmaker.name: Playmaker
the_playmaker.oneLine: A strategic go-getter planning 5 years ahead rather than just today.
the_playmaker.cardLine: A mind that sees the big picture, treating life like a chess board.

the_sweetheart.name: The Sweetheart
the_sweetheart.oneLine: Warm, friendly, and cute; someone everyone instantly gets along with.
the_sweetheart.cardLine: A sweet aura that warms the room with a smile, making it impossible to stay mad.

the_empath.name: The Empath
the_empath.oneLine: An expert reader of people who understands your trouble just by looking at your eyes.
the_empath.cardLine: A confidant who listens to your soul and understands human psychology like a pro.

the_dreamer.name: The Dreamer
the_dreamer.oneLine: A pure-hearted idealist with grand dreams who looks at the world with positive glasses.
the_dreamer.cardLine: A lovely mind keeping their vision clean and sincere, free from real-world cynicism.

the_proud_friend.name: Proud Friend
the_proud_friend.oneLine: Sincere on the outside, but with highly guarded personal boundaries and pride.
the_proud_friend.cardLine: Incredibly warm, but will quietly walk out of your life the second their pride is hurt.

the_ambitious_sweetheart.name: Ambitious Sweetheart
the_ambitious_sweetheart.oneLine: Sweet-talking but focused on goals, climbing to success without breaking hearts.
the_ambitious_sweetheart.cardLine: A determined friend who gets things done with a smile and rises by their own merit.

the_calm_harbor.name: Calm Harbor
the_calm_harbor.oneLine: A warm and quiet soul whose presence feels like a free therapy session.
the_calm_harbor.cardLine: Staying far from drama, a reassuring anchor who calms you down just by being there.

the_seductive_mind.name: Seductive Mind
the_seductive_mind.oneLine: Sharp and attractive; a magnetic intelligence capable of reading any room.
the_seductive_mind.cardLine: A genius who knows exactly what people need, using charm and intellect to lead.

the_aesthetic.name: Aesthetic Vision
the_aesthetic.oneLine: A profile whose style, tastes, and living space look like a curated Pinterest board.
the_aesthetic.cardLine: Always seeking beauty, rejecting ordinary clothes and mundane spots with elegance.

the_charming_anchor.name: Charming Anchor
the_charming_anchor.oneLine: Stunning in stance and someone you can lean on with absolute peace of mind.
the_charming_anchor.cardLine: Not just cool and classy, but a man of his word—a rare combination.

the_star_player.name: Star Player
the_star_player.oneLine: A popular winner with high screen presence who plays only for the top spot.
the_star_player.cardLine: A rare mix of glamorous style and unstoppable career drive.

the_party_host.name: Generous Host
the_party_host.oneLine: The coolest person in the room who is also incredibly sharing and open-handed.
the_party_host.cardLine: A stylish profile who loves treating everyone at the table, never counting the cost.

the_mature_charm.name: Mature Charm
the_mature_charm.oneLine: Attractive and mature, staying far from childish acts and knowing how to behave.
the_mature_charm.cardLine: Catching the eye with style, while commanding respect with a mature stance.

the_consultant.name: Silent Consultant
the_consultant.oneLine: A logic box who analyzes your most critical issues and shows you the best way forward.
the_consultant.cardLine: Pure intelligence combined with absolute discretion; the group's unofficial advisor.

the_know_it_all.name: Brilliant Ego
the_know_it_all.oneLine: A genius who loves being right and feels no need to hide their intellectual ego.
the_know_it_all.cardLine: The brain who can't resist saying 'I told you so' in debates, and usually is right.

the_strategist.name: Master Strategist
the_strategist.oneLine: An intellect driven by logic, calculating every single step toward their goals.
the_strategist.cardLine: A sharp mind who filters ambition through logic and silently hits the target.

the_intellectual_giver.name: Intellectual Giver
the_intellectual_giver.oneLine: A generous mind who loves sharing their knowledge, experience, and resources.
the_intellectual_giver.cardLine: A genius who opens not just their wallet but their mind to guide and nurture friends.

the_innovator.name: Innovator
the_innovator.oneLine: A visionary who can't sit still, constantly producing new ideas and leading the group.
the_innovator.cardLine: A dynamic force hating routine, spreading excitement with their latest projects.

the_idealist.name: Honest Idealist
the_idealist.oneLine: A visionary standing tall, loyal to their values, with no time for lies and deceit.
the_idealist.cardLine: A solid character who never compromises on their truth and doesn't bend with the wind.

the_philanthropist.name: Philanthropist
the_philanthropist.oneLine: An idealist dedicating time and resources to make the world a better place.
the_philanthropist.cardLine: The visionary force and generous soul behind grand supportive projects.

the_philosopher.name: The Philosopher
the_philosopher.oneLine: A thinker questioning the meaning of life, loving deep talks and quiet calmness.
the_philosopher.cardLine: A mature vision opting for philosophy and the future over daily gossip.

the_golden_retriever.name: Golden Retriever
the_golden_retriever.oneLine: Highly energetic and intensely loyal; a friend who would never turn their back on you.
the_golden_retriever.cardLine: The secure space you run to when down, wrapped in pure positive vibes.

the_showman.name: Showman
the_showman.oneLine: Loves the show; a master of pulling the room's energy entirely onto themselves.
the_showman.cardLine: Feeding on attention, managing the stage and the drama with high energy.

the_powerhouse.name: Powerhouse
the_powerhouse.oneLine: Running toward goals with unstoppable ambition and boundless work energy.
the_powerhouse.cardLine: An energetic winner who never tires, acting as the group's chief motivator.

the_life_giver.name: Life Giver
the_life_giver.oneLine: Lively friend bringing life to the group with high energy and open pockets.
the_life_giver.cardLine: An energetic and generous profile always first to fund and spark group plans.

the_steady_vibe.name: Steady Vibe
the_steady_vibe.oneLine: A balanced energy knowing exactly when to double the fun and when to stop.
the_steady_vibe.cardLine: Never loud, never boring; just the perfect, mature recipe for fun.

the_gatekeeper.name: Gatekeeper
the_gatekeeper.oneLine: Keeping distance from the crowd, offering infinite loyalty to a selected few.
the_gatekeeper.cardLine: Their circle of trust is narrow, but once you're in, they will guard you forever.

the_pillar.name: The Pillar
the_pillar.oneLine: Highly consistent in goals and a professional who never lets you down in work.
the_pillar.cardLine: Disciplined, reliable, and refusing to leave success to chance—a solid pillar.

the_helper.name: The Helper
the_helper.oneLine: The first to run to help in times of trouble, offering support with everything.
the_helper.cardLine: Doing good without expecting returns, known for pure generosity and honesty.

the_protector.name: The Protector
the_protector.oneLine: A calm and loyal guardian protecting the group from conflicts and external chaos.
the_protector.cardLine: A protective shield you can lean on, guarding your back with logical solutions.

the_proud_patron.name: Proud Patron
the_proud_patron.oneLine: Proud and distant, yet loving to make grand gestures and gifts to their loved ones.
the_proud_patron.cardLine: Taking pride in treating others, never boasting but making their presence felt.

the_stoic_king.name: Stoic King
the_stoic_king.oneLine: Commanding respect with an unwavering posture and calm, distant behavior.
the_stoic_king.cardLine: Rarely showing emotion, putting down their weight with a stoic presence.

the_patron.name: Big Patron
the_patron.oneLine: An open-handed leader with grand goals, lifting those around as they rise.
the_patron.cardLine: Never celebrating success alone, a generous profile rewarding their team.
